entities.summary: Cleo C. Fields is an American attorney and politician who serves in the United States House of Representatives, currently representing Louisiana's 6th congressional district. He previously represented Louisiana's 4th congressional district from 1993 to 1997 and ran unsuccessfully for governor of Louisiana in 1995. He has served as a member of the Louisiana State Senate on three different occasions. Fields is a member of the Democratic Party. Cleo Fields was a performers & entertainers from Baton Rouge (b. 1962-11-22, Baton Rouge). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
